title: Low-fat Fluffy Midnight Uruguayan Baby Pak Koi Crispy Fritters
description: A delightful Uruguayan dish featuring baby pak koi, made with a light and airy texture, perfect for a midnight snack.

ingredients.name: Whole wheat flour
ingredients.notes: all-purpose flour can be used as a substitute

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, milk, egg, salt, and sugar to make a smooth batter.
Add the chopped parsley to the batter and mix well.
Heat about 1-2 inches of vegetable oil in a large frying pan over medium heat.
When the oil is hot, add a few drops of water to the pan to test the temperature.
If the water sizzles and evaporates quickly, the oil is ready for frying.
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the batter into the hot oil, about 1-2 tbsp each.
Fry the fritters for about 2-3 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and crispy.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate.
Serve the fritters hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
